items.title: Curry Scores 29 as the Warriors Win Their Sixth Straight
items.titleZh: 柯瑞攻下 29 分 勇士 120 比 100 擊敗熱火拿下六連勝
items.teaser: 開季三連敗後，勇士已經連贏六場；柯瑞投進 6 顆三分球，還超越「大 O」羅伯森，升上 NBA 生涯得分榜第 17 名。
paras: Stephen Curry scored 29 points as the Golden State Warriors beat the Miami Heat 120-100 at home on Thursday night. It was the Warriors' sixth straight win after they started the season 0-3. Curry made six 3-pointers, even though he began the game 1 for 8.
週四晚上，柯瑞（Stephen Curry）攻下 29 分，帶領金州勇士在主場以 120 比 100 擊敗邁阿密熱火。勇士在開季吞下三連敗之後，這已經是他們的六連勝。柯瑞雖然開賽 8 投只中 1，最後還是投進了 6 顆三分球。

Early in the game, Curry passed Oscar Robertson to move into 17th place on the NBA's career scoring list. Yaxel Lendeborg added 17 points, eight rebounds and six assists, and Draymond Green had a season-high 11 assists. Golden State outscored Miami 26-9 during one important stretch of the third quarter.
比賽初段，柯瑞超越「大 O」羅伯森（Oscar Robertson），升上 NBA 生涯得分榜第 17 名。Yaxel Lendeborg 貢獻 17 分、8 籃板、6 助攻，格林（Draymond Green）則送出本季新高的 11 次助攻。第三節有一段關鍵時間，勇士打出 26 比 9 的攻勢。

Davion Mitchell led the Heat with 22 points, and Giannis Antetokounmpo had 20 points and 14 rebounds. Former Warriors player Klay Thompson, who now plays for Miami, received a warm welcome from the crowd before the game. He scored 11 points on 3-for-10 shooting.
熱火由 Davion Mitchell 拿下全隊最高的 22 分，字母哥（Giannis Antetokounmpo）則有 20 分、14 籃板。前勇士球員、現在效力熱火的湯普森（Klay Thompson），賽前受到全場觀眾熱烈歡迎。他 10 投 3 中，拿下 11 分。

items.title: TSMC Weighs Making Memory Chips at Nvidia's Request
items.titleZh: 應輝達要求 台積電傳評估跨足 3D DRAM 記憶體
items.teaser: AI 資料中心吃掉大量記憶體、價格飆漲，據報台積電已開始草擬生產 3D DRAM 的計畫，未來可能和三星、SK 海力士、美光正面競爭。
paras: TSMC, the world's largest chipmaker, has begun drafting plans to make advanced memory chips called 3D DRAM, according to a report by The Information. The move comes at the request of Nvidia, TSMC's biggest customer. 3D DRAM stacks memory cells vertically to fit more capacity into a chip.
根據 The Information 的報導，全球最大的晶片製造商台積電已經開始草擬計畫，要生產一種叫做 3D DRAM 的先進記憶體晶片。這是應台積電最大客戶輝達的要求。3D DRAM 把記憶單元垂直堆疊，讓一顆晶片能裝進更多容量。

AI data centers are using huge amounts of memory, so prices have soared and supplies are short. Micron expects the shortage to last into 2028. TSMC could build new factories or buy an existing plant and convert it, but no timeline has been reported.
AI 資料中心正在消耗大量記憶體，導致價格飆漲、供應吃緊。美光預期這波短缺會持續到 2028 年。台積電可能蓋新廠，或買下現有的工廠加以改造，但目前還沒有關於時程的報導。

The project is reportedly led by Hsu Kuo-chin, a TSMC vice president who oversees advanced packaging. If it goes ahead, TSMC would compete with memory makers such as Samsung, SK hynix and Micron. TSMC and Nvidia did not immediately respond to requests for comment.
據報這項計畫由負責先進封裝的台積電副總經理徐國晉主導。如果計畫成真，台積電將和三星、SK 海力士、美光等記憶體大廠競爭。台積電和輝達都沒有立即回應置評請求。
words: stacks · stacked · stacking｜n. stack 一疊；一堆｜stacked memory 堆疊式記憶體
soars · soared · soaring｜soaring prices 飆漲的價格
複數 shortages｜a memory shortage 記憶體短缺｜adj. short 不足的

analysis.note: is led by… 是被動語態：「由…主導」。reportedly 插在 be 動詞和過去分詞中間，意思是「據報導」，表示消息還沒經過官方證實。a TSMC vice president 是同位語，說明徐國晉的身分，後面的 who 子句再補充他負責什麼。

quiz.ex: 第二段：Micron expects the shortage to last into 2028。

items.title: Experts Say Taiwan-U.S. Economic Ties Will Hold After the Midterms
items.titleZh: 美國期中選舉變天 台灣學者看台美關係
items.teaser: 美國民主黨拿下參眾兩院多數，台灣學者在論壇上分析影響：有人認為台美經濟整合不會受影響，也有人提醒要注意美國地方限制和國會關係。
paras: After Democrats won majorities in both the House and the Senate in Tuesday's U.S. midterm elections, Taiwanese experts discussed what the result could mean for Taiwan at a forum in Taipei on Thursday. Roy Lee of the Chung-Hua Institution for Economic Research said Taiwan's trade and investment ties with the U.S. are unlikely to be derailed.
美國民主黨在週二的期中選舉中拿下眾議院和參議院的多數席次後，台灣學者週四在台北的一場論壇上，討論這個結果對台灣可能有什麼影響。中華經濟研究院的李淳表示，台灣和美國之間的貿易與投資關係，不太可能因此脫軌。

Lee expects Congress to seek a bigger role in tariff and technology policy. However, he said that even if reviews of the Taiwan-U.S. trade agreement take longer, economic integration between the two sides will continue.
李淳預期，美國國會會在關稅和科技政策上爭取更大的角色。不過他說，就算台美貿易協定的審查拖得比較久，雙方的經濟整合仍會持續。

Others were more cautious. Ronan Fu of Academia Sinica said voters punished Trump over living costs but did not develop a strong attachment to the Democrats. Wu Chung-li, also of Academia Sinica, warned that local limits on electricity, water and land could affect Taiwanese AI investment in the U.S., and said Taiwan must rebuild ties with Congress.
其他學者的看法比較保守。中研院的傅澤民說，選民是因為生活開銷而懲罰川普，但並沒有因此對民主黨產生強烈的認同。同樣來自中研院的吳重禮則提醒，美國地方在電力、用水和土地上的限制，可能影響台灣在美國的 AI 投資，他也說台灣必須重建和美國國會的關係。
words: 複數 majorities｜win a majority 贏得多數｜反義 minority 少數
derails · derailed · derailing｜n. derailment 出軌
複數 tariffs｜impose tariffs on… 對…課徵關稅
不可數｜v. integrate · integrated · integrating｜economic integration 經濟整合

parts: to seek a bigger role in tariff and technology policy.
analysis.note: expect＋受詞＋to V＝預期某人會做某事。to seek… 說明受詞 Congress 會做什麼，所以是受詞補語。seek a role in… ＝爭取在…中的角色。

quiz.ex: 第三段：voters punished Trump over living costs。

items.title: Hundreds of Ice Age Engravings Found in a Tourist Cave in Spain
items.titleZh: 觀光洞穴藏玄機 西班牙發現 280 個冰河時期刻畫
items.teaser: 遊客走過幾十年都沒發現，有人甚至把名字刻在上面——西班牙一座觀光洞穴裡，藏著 280 個冰河時期的刻畫，包括一隻豎著耳朵的熊。
paras: Archaeologists have identified 280 Ice Age engravings in Cova de la Font Major, a cave in Catalonia, northeastern Spain. The cave has been open to the public for decades, and some visitors even scratched their own names over the ancient art without knowing it was there.
考古學家在西班牙東北部加泰隆尼亞的 Font Major 洞穴（Cova de la Font Major）裡，辨認出 280 個冰河時期的刻畫。這個洞穴已經對外開放了幾十年，有些遊客甚至在不知情的情況下，把自己的名字刻在這些古老的藝術上。

Archaeologist Josep Maria Vergès Bosch first noticed the engravings among modern graffiti in 2019. The new study, published in the journal Antiquity, counts 55 animal figures, including horses, deer, wild cattle and goat-like animals. One notable image is a bear with forward-facing ears and a slightly open mouth.
考古學家 Josep Maria Vergès Bosch 在 2019 年，從一堆現代塗鴉中第一次注意到這些刻畫。這份刊登在《Antiquity》期刊的新研究，算出 55 個動物圖像，包括馬、鹿、野牛和像山羊的動物。其中一幅很特別：一隻耳朵朝前、嘴巴微微張開的熊。

The engravings have not been dated directly, but material from deeper parts of the cave shows that humans were active there roughly 40,800 to 25,900 years ago. The cave is now the third-largest known collection of Paleolithic cave art on the Mediterranean side of the Iberian Peninsula.
這些刻畫還沒有被直接定年，但洞穴更深處的材料顯示，大約 4 萬 800 年到 2 萬 5,900 年前就有人類在那裡活動。這座洞穴現在是伊比利半島地中海沿岸已知第三大的舊石器時代洞穴藝術群。

analysis.note: has been＋for＋一段時間，表示從過去持續到現在的狀態。open 在這裡是形容詞「開放的」，當主詞補語。without＋V-ing＝在沒有…的情況下，without knowing＝不知道。

items.title: Luka Doncic Scores 53 as the Lakers Come Back to Beat Portland
items.titleZh: 唐西奇狂轟 53 分 湖人逆轉拓荒者
items.teaser: 半場結束前一記 62 呎超遠壓哨球點燃逆轉，唐西奇單場 53 分，連續四場 40 分以上，追平湖人隊史傳奇。
paras: Luka Doncic scored a season-high 53 points as the Los Angeles Lakers beat the Portland Trail Blazers 124-118 on Friday night at Crypto.com Arena. A 62-foot shot by Doncic at the halftime buzzer helped spark the Lakers' comeback win. His scoring average is now above 40 points per game.
週五晚上在 Crypto.com 球場，唐西奇（Luka Doncic）攻下本季新高的 53 分，帶領洛杉磯湖人以 124 比 118 擊敗波特蘭拓荒者。唐西奇在上半場結束的蜂鳴聲中投進一記 62 呎（約 19 公尺）的超遠球，幫忙點燃湖人的逆轉勝。他的場均得分現在超過 40 分。

It was Doncic's sixth 40-point game of the season and his second 50-point game. He now has 11 career 50-point games, which ties him for 10th place in NBA history. He also joined Kobe Bryant, Elgin Baylor and George Mikan as the only Lakers to score at least 40 points in four games in a row.
這是唐西奇本季第六場 40 分以上、第二場 50 分以上的比賽。他生涯已經有 11 場 50 分比賽，並列 NBA 史上第 10 名。他也和柯比（Kobe Bryant）、貝勒（Elgin Baylor）、麥肯（George Mikan）並列，成為湖人隊史上僅有的連續四場至少拿 40 分的球員。

Before the game, Portland coach Micah Nori called Doncic "the MVP right now." Lakers coach JJ Redick said Doncic can do things that few players, if any, can do. Doncic stayed calm, saying, "We're 10 games in. We've got 72 left."
賽前，拓荒者總教練 Micah Nori 稱唐西奇是「現在的 MVP」。湖人總教練雷迪克（JJ Redick）說，唐西奇能做到一些就算有人做得到、也寥寥無幾的事。唐西奇本人很冷靜，他說：「我們才打了 10 場，還剩 72 場。」

items.title: TSMC Pushes Back on Report About Making Memory Chips
items.titleZh: 3D DRAM 傳聞後續 台積電：專注晶圓代工本業
items.teaser: 前一天才傳出台積電應輝達要求評估做記憶體，台積電隨即回應「專注本業」；分析也指出 3D DRAM 至少還要好幾年才會成熟。
paras: Shortly after a report said TSMC was drafting plans to make 3D DRAM memory chips at Nvidia's request, the chipmaker pushed back. A TSMC spokesperson told Tom's Hardware that the company "focuses on our core business at all times, which is dedicated IC foundry."
才有報導指出台積電應輝達要求、正在草擬生產 3D DRAM 記憶體晶片的計畫，這家晶片製造商很快就出面回應。台積電發言人告訴 Tom's Hardware，公司「隨時都專注在核心業務，也就是專業積體電路晶圓代工」。

TSMC added that its mission is to be a trusted technology and capacity provider for the global logic chip industry. In other words, it plans to remain a logic foundry rather than become a memory maker. The original report, from The Information, had cited two people familiar with the plan.
台積電補充說，公司的使命是成為全球邏輯晶片產業值得信賴的技術與產能提供者。換句話說，它打算繼續當邏輯晶片代工廠，而不是變成記憶體製造商。最早的報導來自 The Information，當時引述了兩位知情人士的說法。

Tom's Hardware also argued that 3D DRAM, which stacks memory cells vertically, is still years away even for major memory makers such as Micron, Samsung and SK hynix. Micron plans at least four more generations of flat DRAM technology before 3D DRAM becomes a reality, so the article says 3D DRAM cannot ease the memory shortage for at least five years.
Tom's Hardware 也分析，把記憶單元垂直堆疊的 3D DRAM，就算對美光、三星、SK 海力士這些記憶體大廠來說，也還要好幾年才能實現。美光在 3D DRAM 成真之前，還規劃了至少四代平面 DRAM 製程，所以文章認為，3D DRAM 至少五年內都無法緩解記憶體短缺。

items.title: Premier Refuses to Countersign Bill on Seniors' Health Insurance Premiums
items.titleZh: 老人健保費全額補助法案 卓榮泰拒絕副署
items.teaser: 立法院通過由中央全額補助長者健保費的修法，行政院以違憲、排擠其他福利為由拒絕副署；在野黨則認為副署制度不是用來讓閣揆推翻立法院。
paras: Premier Cho Jung-tai has refused to countersign an amendment that would require the central government to fully pay National Health Insurance premiums for eligible seniors. The Legislature passed the bill in a 60-39 vote with support from the opposition Kuomintang (KMT) and Taiwan People's Party (TPP), which together hold a majority.
行政院長卓榮泰拒絕副署一項修正案，這項修法要求中央政府全額負擔符合資格長者的全民健保保費。立法院以 60 比 39 表決通過這項法案，支持的是合計掌握多數席次的在野黨國民黨和民眾黨。

Cabinet spokesperson Michelle Lee said the bill would cost an estimated NT$40 billion a year and would infringe on the Cabinet's constitutional authority over policy and budgets. She also warned that the money could be taken from long-term care and other welfare programs, and that about 66,000 low-income seniors could lose help with medical costs.
行政院發言人李慧芝表示，這項法案每年估計要花新台幣 400 億元，而且侵害了憲法賦予行政院的政策與預算權。她也提醒，這筆錢可能會排擠長照和其他福利計畫，而且約 6 萬 6,000 名中低收入長者可能失去醫療費用的補助。

Under the Constitution, the president needs the premier's countersignature to promulgate laws. The opposition parties argue that this rule is meant to limit presidential power, not to let the premier override the Legislature, and say the Cabinet should ask lawmakers to reconsider instead. Nine bills passed by the Legislature have now been blocked this way.
根據憲法，總統公布法律需要行政院長副署。在野黨認為，這項規定是為了限制總統的權力，而不是讓行政院長推翻立法院的決定，並表示行政院應該改為提請立法院覆議。目前已經有九項立法院通過的法案，因為這樣而無法生效。

items.title: A Surprise Right Whale Calf Is Found in Canada
items.titleZh: 意外的驚喜 加拿大海灣發現露脊鯨寶寶
items.teaser: 全世界只剩約 380 頭的露脊鯨，又多了一頭寶寶——而且牠一整年都沒被研究人員看到，直到在加拿大魁北克外海現身。
paras: Scientists have confirmed a surprise baby right whale in Canada's Gulf of St. Lawrence. Researchers from the Mingan Island Cetacean Study photographed the calf on Sept. 25 near Anticosti Island, Quebec. The New England Aquarium in Boston announced the news this week.
科學家證實，在加拿大聖羅倫斯灣出現了一頭意外的露脊鯨寶寶。明根島鯨豚研究組織（Mingan Island Cetacean Study）的研究人員在 9 月 25 日，於魁北克的安蒂科斯蒂島附近拍到這頭幼鯨。波士頓的新英格蘭水族館在本週公布了這個消息。

The calf is a surprise because researchers never saw it during winter, spring or summer surveys along the U.S. East Coast. It was probably born months ago, and it now weighs almost 7 tonnes. Its mother is Silt, a 38-year-old whale who was seen briefly in the southeastern U.S. in February.
這頭幼鯨之所以令人驚喜，是因為研究人員在冬天、春天和夏天沿著美國東岸的調查中，從來沒有看過牠。牠可能幾個月前就出生了，現在已經將近 7 公噸重。牠的媽媽是 38 歲的露脊鯨 Silt，今年 2 月曾在美國東南部短暫出現。

The calf brings this season's total to 24, the best year since 2009. That is good news, because only about 380 right whales are left in the world, including about 70 females of breeding age. Collisions with ships, fishing gear and warming oceans are still serious threats.
這頭幼鯨讓這一季的新生寶寶總數達到 24 頭，是 2009 年以來最好的一年。這是個好消息，因為全世界只剩大約 380 頭露脊鯨，其中能生育的母鯨只有約 70 頭。被船撞、被漁具纏住，以及海洋暖化，仍然是嚴重的威脅。

items.title: Jokic and the Nuggets Beat the Pacers in Mexico City
items.titleZh: 約基奇領軍 金塊在墨西哥城擊敗溜馬
items.teaser: NBA 第 35 場在墨西哥舉行的比賽，金塊以 114 比 102 獲勝，約基奇差兩次助攻就是大三元。
paras: The Denver Nuggets beat the Indiana Pacers 114-102 on Saturday in Mexico City. It was the 35th NBA game ever played in Mexico, including 16 regular-season games and 19 preseason games. One highlight of the night came when Jamal Murray went the full 94 feet of the court to score.
金塊週六在墨西哥城以 114 比 102 擊敗印第安納溜馬。這是 NBA 史上第 35 場在墨西哥舉行的比賽，其中 16 場是例行賽、19 場是季前賽。當晚的精彩時刻之一，是莫瑞（Jamal Murray）一路從後場殺到前場、跑完整整 94 呎（約 29 公尺）的球場得分。

Nikola Jokic came close to another triple-double. He finished with 19 points, 13 rebounds and eight assists, just two assists short of a triple-double. Cameron Johnson added 18 points for Denver, which improved to 5-3 this season.
約基奇（Nikola Jokic）又差一點拿下大三元。他攻下 19 分、13 個籃板和 8 次助攻，只差兩次助攻就是大三元。卡麥隆．強森（Cameron Johnson）替金塊貢獻 18 分，金塊本季戰績提升到 5 勝 3 敗。

For Indiana, Pascal Siakam scored 23 points in his 700th career game and passed 13,000 career points. Larry Nance Jr. made five 3-pointers, tying his career best, and the Pacers' bench outscored Denver's 52-43. Still, Indiana fell to 3-7.
溜馬方面，席亞康（Pascal Siakam）在生涯第 700 場比賽拿下 23 分，生涯總得分突破 13,000 分。小南斯（Larry Nance Jr.）投進 5 記三分球，追平個人生涯紀錄；溜馬的板凳球員也以 52 比 43 壓過金塊的替補。不過溜馬戰績還是掉到 3 勝 7 敗。

items.title: AI Boom Makes Chip Packaging the Next Big Battleground
items.titleZh: AI 熱潮 讓晶片封裝成為半導體新戰場
items.teaser: AI 晶片需求超過封裝產能，輝達、AMD 和台灣廠商都在擴產；先進封裝的營收今年可望首度超越傳統封裝。
paras: Demand for AI chips is now greater than the available packaging capacity, so companies from Nvidia and AMD to smaller players in Taiwan are expanding production. According to the research firm Yole Group, revenue from advanced packaging is forecast to overtake revenue from traditional packaging for the first time this year.
AI 晶片的需求現在已經超過可用的封裝產能，所以從輝達、AMD 到台灣規模較小的廠商，都在擴大生產。根據研究機構 Yole Group，先進封裝的營收預計今年將首度超越傳統封裝。

TSMC, the world's largest contract chipmaker, dominates the most advanced packaging technology, including CoWoS. According to one industry executive, Nvidia is providing billions of dollars to help expand CoWoS capacity at SPIL, a unit of ASE.
全球最大的晶圓代工廠台積電，主導最先進的封裝技術，包括 CoWoS。一位業界主管表示，輝達正提供數十億美元，協助日月光投控旗下的矽品擴充 CoWoS 產能。

Other firms want more choices. "Everyone is looking for a solution outside TSMC," said Powertech chairman Tsai Du-kung. His company plans to invest US$400 million in a packaging joint venture with Broadcom in Singapore. Pat Gelsinger, the former head of Intel, has estimated that packaging could eventually account for as much as half the value of a chip.
其他公司則希望有更多選擇。力成董事長蔡篤恭說：「大家都在找台積電以外的解決方案。」力成計畫投資 4 億美元，在新加坡和博通成立封裝合資公司。英特爾前執行長季辛格（Pat Gelsinger）估計，封裝最後可能占一顆晶片價值的一半之多。

items.title: Taipei Mayoral Rivals Step Up Campaigns Three Weeks Before the Election
items.titleZh: 選前三週 台北市長候選人加強選戰
items.teaser: 距離 11 月 28 日地方選舉剩三週，藍綠台北市長候選人各自規劃遊行、車隊掃街，也到高雄替同黨候選人助選。
paras: With three weeks to go before Taiwan's Nov. 28 local elections, the two main candidates for Taipei mayor stepped up their campaigns on Saturday. The campaign of Mayor Chiang Wan-an of the Kuomintang (KMT) called on supporters to join a march and rally on Nov. 14. The two groups of marchers will start from his campaign headquarters and Daan Park and meet outside Taipei City Hall.
距離 11 月 28 日的地方選舉還有三週，兩位主要的台北市長候選人週六都加強了選戰。國民黨籍市長蔣萬安的競選團隊號召支持者參加 11 月 14 日的遊行和造勢大會。兩路遊行隊伍會分別從他的競選總部和大安森林公園出發，在台北市政府外會合。

Puma Shen, the Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) candidate, led a motorcade through two Taipei districts, starting in Neihu. Sports Minister Lee Yang joined the motorcade. Shen said his invitation to Lee was connected to his policy proposals for Neihu and Nangang.
民進黨候選人沈伯洋率領車隊從內湖出發，掃街經過台北兩個行政區。運動部長李洋也加入車隊。沈伯洋說，邀請李洋和他對內湖、南港的政策主張有關。

Both parties also turned to Kaohsiung. Chiang joined KMT candidate Ko Chih-en, who was also backed by Taiwan People's Party Chairman Huang Kuo-chang. Ko promised to set up an office to deal with uneven resources if she is elected. At a DPP rally, President Lai Ching-te backed DPP candidate Lai Jui-lung.
兩黨也都把目光轉向高雄。蔣萬安陪同國民黨候選人柯志恩造勢，民眾黨主席黃國昌也到場支持柯志恩。柯志恩承諾，如果當選，會成立辦公室，處理資源分配不均的問題。在民進黨的造勢場合，總統賴清德替民進黨候選人賴瑞隆站台。

複數 candidates｜n. candidacy 參選

items.title: A Medieval Church Bigger Than the White House in Sudan
items.titleZh: 比白宮還大！蘇丹中世紀巨型教堂
items.teaser: 波蘭和蘇丹的考古團隊在古城舊棟古拉挖掘一座巨大教堂，比美國白宮還大，可能曾是主教座堂。
paras: Archaeologists in Sudan are uncovering a huge medieval church that may once have been a cathedral. The building stands in Old Dongola, an ancient town within the borders of today's Sudan. It is about 47 meters wide and 57 meters long, and its height may have reached 21 meters.
蘇丹的考古學家正在挖掘一座巨大的中世紀教堂，它過去可能是一座主教座堂。這棟建築位於舊棟古拉（Old Dongola），一座位在今天蘇丹境內的古城。教堂寬約 47 公尺、長約 57 公尺，高度可能達到 21 公尺。

A Polish-Sudanese team led by Prof. Artur Obluski of the University of Warsaw is working at the site. Researchers first detected the building, known as the Great Church of Jesus, in 2021. They have also found monumental stairs leading to the church entrance.
一支由華沙大學奧布盧斯基（Artur Obluski）教授帶領的波蘭與蘇丹聯合團隊正在現場工作。研究人員在 2021 年首次發現這棟被稱為「耶穌大教堂」的建築。他們也找到了一道通往教堂入口的宏偉階梯。

The excavations have grown with support from the Polish National Science Centre. Obluski, who directs the excavation, gave a simple way to picture the size. "This building is larger than the White House in Washington," he said. "And we plan to excavate it."
在波蘭國家科學中心的支持下，挖掘工作的規模越來越大。負責主持挖掘的奧布盧斯基用一個簡單的方式來形容它有多大：「這棟建築比華盛頓的白宮還大，」他說，「而我們打算把它挖出來。」
words: 比較 the Middle Ages 中世紀

excavates · excavated · excavating｜n. excavation 挖掘工作

analysis.zh: 蘇丹的考古學家正在挖掘一座巨大的中世紀教堂，它過去可能是一座主教座堂。

analysis.note: that 引導關係子句修飾前面的 church。may have＋p.p.＝對過去的推測「過去可能是…」，may once have been a cathedral＝以前可能是主教座堂。

parts: 現在分詞片語（修飾 stairs）

quiz.ex: 第二段：Researchers first detected the building … in 2021。

quiz.ex: 第三段："This building is larger than the White House in Washington."

items.title: Austin Reaves Scores 43 as Lakers Beat Pistons Without Doncic
items.titleZh: 東契奇缺陣 里夫斯狂砍 43 分助湖人擊敗活塞
items.teaser: 湖人當家球星東契奇沒上場，里夫斯挺身而出攻下 43 分，最後還靠一記「運氣好」的三分球鎖定勝利。
paras: The Los Angeles Lakers beat the Detroit Pistons 121-116 on Sunday in Detroit, even though their star Luka Doncic did not play. Austin Reaves stepped in and scored 43 points. He also made all 11 of his free throws.
洛杉磯湖人週日在底特律以 121 比 116 擊敗活塞，雖然當家球星東契奇（Luka Doncic）沒有上場。里夫斯（Austin Reaves）挺身而出，攻下 43 分，罰球也 11 罰全中。

The Pistons trailed by 26 points in the second quarter, but they fought back. They were down only 109-104 going into the final minute. Then Reaves hit an off-balance 3-pointer just before the shot clock expired, and Detroit's last chance was gone.
活塞在第二節一度落後 26 分，但他們奮力反撲，進入最後一分鐘時只落後 109 比 104。接著里夫斯在進攻時間快結束前，投進一記身體失去平衡的三分球，活塞最後的機會就這樣沒了。

After the game, Reaves joked that the shot was "100% lucky." Walker Kessler added 12 points and 16 rebounds for Los Angeles, which improved to 9-2, the best record in the West. It was the Lakers' fifth win in a row, while Detroit fell to 6-3.
賽後里夫斯開玩笑說，那一球「百分之百是運氣」。凱斯勒（Walker Kessler）替湖人貢獻 12 分、16 個籃板，湖人戰績提升到 9 勝 2 敗，是西區最佳戰績。這是湖人的五連勝，活塞則掉到 6 勝 3 敗。
words: trails · trailed · trailing｜trail by 10 points 落後 10 分｜n. trail 小徑；痕跡
luckier · luckiest｜n. luck｜adv. luckily｜反義 unlucky
複數 rebounds｜v. rebound /rɪˈbaʊnd/ 反彈；回升
複數 records｜v. record /rɪˈkɔːrd/ 記錄；錄製

analysis.note: trail by＋差距＝落後多少分，by 表示「差距」，例如 win by 5 points（贏 5 分）。fight back＝反擊、反撲，fight 的過去式是不規則的 fought。but 連接兩個完整的句子，前後各有自己的主詞和動詞。

parts: 關係子句（補充說明湖人）

analysis.note: 逗號後的 which 引導非限定關係子句，補充說明前面的 Los Angeles（湖人）。最後的 the best record in the West 是同位語，用名詞片語再解釋一次 9-2 是什麼。improve to＋戰績＝戰績提升到…。

quiz.ex: 第一段：Austin Reaves stepped in and scored 43 points。12 和 16 是凱斯勒的得分和籃板，26 是活塞一度落後的分數。

opts: The game was played in Los Angeles.

quiz.ex: 第三段：which improved to 9-2, the best record in the West。比賽在底特律；里夫斯罰球 11 罰全中；落後 26 分的是活塞。

items.title: TSMC Plays Down Report of a Move into Memory Chips
items.titleZh: 台積電淡化進軍記憶體晶片的報導
items.teaser: 外媒報導台積電應輝達要求研究生產 3D DRAM，台積電回應會專注晶圓代工本業；業界認為短期內跨入記憶體並不容易。
paras: TSMC has played down a report that it might start making memory chips for Nvidia, its largest customer. On November 6, the tech news site The Information reported that TSMC had begun drawing up plans to produce 3D DRAM at Nvidia's request. The report said the timing and the method of securing factories had not been decided.
台積電淡化一則報導，報導說它可能開始替最大客戶輝達生產記憶體晶片。科技新聞網站 The Information 在 11 月 6 日報導，台積電已經應輝達的要求，開始擬定生產 3D DRAM 的計畫。報導也說，生產時程和取得廠房的方式都還沒有決定。

In response, TSMC said it was concentrating on its core foundry business. The company, which holds more than 70% of the global foundry market, said providing technology and manufacturing capacity to the logic chip industry remains its mission.
台積電回應說，公司專注在晶圓代工的核心本業。這家掌握全球超過七成晶圓代工市場的公司表示，為邏輯晶片產業提供技術和製造產能，仍然是它的使命。

Industry officials say a quick move into memory would be difficult, because logic chips and DRAM use different processes and facilities. The memory market has long been led by Samsung Electronics, SK hynix and Micron, and all three are currently developing 3D DRAM.
業界人士表示，台積電要在短時間內跨入記憶體並不容易，因為邏輯晶片和 DRAM 使用不同的製程和設備。記憶體市場長期由三星電子、SK 海力士和美光領先，而這三家公司目前也都在開發 3D DRAM。
words: 複數 foundries｜foundry business 晶圓代工業務｜pure-play foundry 專業代工廠

items.title: Taiwan Closes Its Office in Papua New Guinea as U.S. Voices Concern
items.titleZh: 台灣關閉駐巴紐辦事處 美國表達關切
items.teaser: 巴布亞紐幾內亞以「一個中國」政策為由要求關閉台灣辦事處，外交部決定撤館並全面檢討雙邊關係，美國國務院表示深感關切。
paras: Taiwan has decided to close its office in Papua New Guinea (PNG) after pressure from the PNG government. The Taipei Economic Office in Port Moresby was set up in February 1990, even though the two sides have no official diplomatic ties.
在巴布亞紐幾內亞（巴紐）政府施壓後，台灣決定關閉駐巴紐的辦事處。位於莫士比港的台北經濟辦事處在 1990 年 2 月設立，雖然雙方並沒有正式邦交。

In July, PNG's foreign minister announced that the office must close immediately, citing the country's "one-China" policy. Taiwan protested and stopped buying spot LNG from PNG. After PNG recently repeated its demand, Taiwan's foreign ministry said on Friday that it would withdraw all its staff and fully review the relationship.
7 月時，巴紐外交部長宣布辦事處必須立即關閉，理由是該國遵守「一個中國」政策。台灣提出抗議，並停止向巴紐購買液化天然氣現貨。巴紐最近再次提出要求後，台灣外交部週五表示，將撤回所有駐館人員，並全面檢討雙邊關係。

A U.S. State Department spokesman said Washington was deeply concerned by PNG's decision. He described Taiwan as a reliable and democratic partner and called the closure "yet another example of Beijing's intimidation campaign" against Taiwan.
美國國務院一位發言人表示，美方對巴紐的決定深感關切。他形容台灣是可靠的民主夥伴，並稱這次關閉辦事處是「北京對台灣恐嚇行動的又一個例子」。
words: n. diplomacy · diplomat｜adv. diplomatically｜diplomatic ties 邦交
protests · protested · protesting｜n. protest /ˈproʊtest/ 抗議
不可數｜v. intimidate · intimidated · intimidating｜adj. intimidating

parts: that the office must close immediately,
analysis.note: citing … 是分詞構句，主詞和主要子句相同（外交部長），等於 and he cited …。cite 在新聞裡常表示「以…為理由」：citing safety concerns（以安全考量為由）。

items.title: Gas Leaks Hint That Mars May Still Be Volcanically Active
items.titleZh: 神祕氣體外洩 暗示火星火山可能還「活著」
items.teaser: 歐洲太空總署的軌道器在火星火山裂縫上方，夏天反常地測到大量氯化氫，科學家推測地底可能有休眠的岩漿庫。
paras: A European spacecraft has found signs that Mars may still have volcanic activity. ESA's ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter repeatedly detected unusually high levels of hydrogen chloride in early northern summer above fractures in the Alba Mons volcanic region. Normally, this gas peaks in winter and falls to very low levels in summer.
一艘歐洲太空船發現跡象，顯示火星可能仍有火山活動。歐洲太空總署的「微量氣體軌道器」（ExoMars Trace Gas Orbiter）在北半球初夏時，多次在亞巴山（Alba Mons）火山區的裂縫上方，測到含量異常高的氯化氫。這種氣體通常在冬天達到高峰，夏天則降到非常低。

Scientists think ice may seal the cracks during winter, when temperatures reach about -120°C. As the surface warms, the ice disappears and gases from underground can escape. The team suggests that the source could be a dormant magma chamber beneath the volcano.
科學家認為，冬天氣溫降到約零下 120 度時，冰可能把裂縫封住。等到地表變暖，冰消失了，地底的氣體就能跑出來。研究團隊推測，氣體來源可能是火山底下一個休眠中的岩漿庫。

"Our findings suggest that Mars has retained enough internal heat to support volcanic activity until recently," said researcher Daniel Mège. However, the study does not show that Mars is erupting today or that life exists beneath its surface.
研究人員梅吉（Daniel Mège）說：「我們的發現顯示，火星保留了足夠的內部熱量，讓火山活動一直延續到不久之前。」不過，這項研究並沒有證明火星現在正在噴發，也沒有證明地表下有生命存在。
words: seals · sealed · sealing｜n. seal 封條；海豹
a dormant volcano 休火山｜比較 active volcano 活火山｜n. dormancy

analysis.zh: 科學家認為，冬天氣溫降到約零下 120 度時，冰可能把裂縫封住。
parts: ice may seal the cracks during winter,

analysis.note: think 後面接省略 that 的名詞子句。may seal 用助動詞 may 表示「可能」，是科學家的推測，不是確定的事實。逗號後的 when 子句補充說明 winter 是什麼樣的時候，等於 in winter, temperatures reach …。

analysis.zh: 等到地表變暖，冰消失了，地底的氣體就能跑出來。
analysis.note: as 可以表示「隨著／當…時」，這裡同時有時間和因果的意味。and 連接兩個完整的句子：the ice disappears 和 gases … can escape。from underground 修飾 gases，說明氣體從哪裡來。
